senses: a descendant of Judah, son of Shallum in the line of Ahlai
a descendant of David and one of the seven introduced into the royal line on the failure of it in the person of Jehoiachin

strongs.def: Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites
strongs.from: from H6965 (קוּם) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will rise
